title: Penny Pinchers
description: Comedic legends Pinky and the Brain stumble upon a small fortune and discover the difficulties in keeping it.
quote: Look Brain! A penny! It’s our lucky day!
altHero: Pinky and Brain standing on the street next to a penny
alt1: Pinky and Brain chasing the penny as it rolls down the street
alt2: a man’s shoe stomps on and squashes Brain as Pinky cringes
alt3: Pink holds the penny out with two hands
alt4: a safe has fallen on Brain
